description: Expanding an unknown list skips the other arguments, so errors in them aren't reported
notes: The spec doesn't say how an unknown value expands, but nothing lets a call ignore an error in another argument: nope isn't a variable. hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown or of the dynamic pseudo-type, before evaluating the other arguments or mapping them to parameters (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
